description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NSF NHERI 2025: Simulating Geotechnical Engineering Applications with Gaussian Splatting, a Robotic Arm, and Large Language Models is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Zachary Thomas, Spring Hill College (shc.edu). The purpose of this research is to make progress towards building an accurate, easy-to-use, and real-time simulation platform for specific applications in the field of Geotechnical Engineering. The methods in this research can be reused and further built upon by addressing the described limitations of this work. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-fh5q-qx48. Keywords: NSF NHERI DesignSafe, 3D Gaussian Splatting, Large Language Models, Robotics, Simulation, Geotechnical Engineering. Published 2025-08-15. Facility named: DesignSafe. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
